## About
Mallard Auto Care started as a family-run shop with one simple goal: to be a local auto shop people can truly trust. We're not a big chain. We're your neighborhood auto care team, and we want you to always know who's working on your car and why.
We take the time to explain every repair, offer fair estimates and treat your vehicle as if it were our own. Our certified technicians handle everything from a simple oil change to complex engine diagnostics, and we're the East Bay's Michelin Tire Center.
Like our namesake, the mallard, we're built for the long haul. We recycle parts and materials and support local conservation efforts. Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 1001 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake and ABS repair: Brake and anti-lock brake diagnostics, repair and replacement. It's one of our specialties.
- Tire sales, mounting and balancing: Sport, winter and all-season tires, fitted and balanced for your vehicle.
- Wheel alignment and suspension: Alignment and suspension work to keep your car tracking straight and riding smooth.
- Oil changes and preventive maintenance: Routine oil changes and maintenance to keep things running smoothly.
- Heating and air conditioning: Repair for your car's heating and air conditioning.
- Complete automotive diagnostics: Finding the cause of warning lights, odd noises and other problems before we fix anything.
- Battery, electrical and engine repair: Battery replacement, electrical work and engine repair.
- Transmission and cooling system service: Transmission service and repair, plus radiator and cooling system work.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Can I book an appointment online?
A: Yes. Use our online system to pick a time that works for you, or give us a call.

Q: Will you explain what my car needs before you fix it?
A: Yes. We walk you through every repair and give you a fair estimate, with no hidden fees or unnecessary upsells.
